prose.name: Infestation: Unsigned Survey on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The owners of the <Place> can't draw a credit on it until an assessor signs it off, and she won't while anything is living in it. Something is.
prose.card: Local Contract. Our site at the <Place> on <Planet> cannot be assessed while it is infested. Clear the creatures from the site so the survey can proceed. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: Nothing's living at the <Place> any more except the weeds. The assessor can come and sign it off.
say: The assessor's on her way. She says she'll need to check the weeds as well. I've told her you don't do weeds.

broadcast: The assessor won't set foot on our site while anything's living there. We'd quite like her to set foot on it.
